Description: Real-time overview cards: active boarders, today's arrivals/departures, open tasks, revenue. Refreshes on load.
Branch managers and below see only their branch data. Super-admins see all branches aggregated.
Shows current live kennel occupancy count with capacity. Colour-coded by fill percentage.
Today's payments received and monthly total displayed on the dashboard header.
Sidebar with role-filtered navigation links to all modules. Collapses on mobile.
Paginated client list with name/phone/email search, status filter, and branch filter.
Full client record: personal details, linked pets, booking history, invoice history, wallet balance, onboarding status.
Form to create or edit client with name, phone, email, home branch, source, notes.
View all pets linked to a client from the client profile, with direct links to pet profiles.
Full booking history for a client filterable by status and date range.
One-click WhatsApp deep-link from client profile opens a pre-populated message in WhatsApp.
Super admins can archive/restore clients. Archived clients are excluded from all operational views.
Staff can preview the client's My Pets portal access link from the client profile.
Full pet record: name, type, breed, size, DOB, vaccination status, microchip, medical history, preferences/allergies, special care flags, medication details.
Form to create or update a pet linked to a client. Includes vaccination status and medical fields.
Pets flagged with vaccination status (vaccinated / partial / unvaccinated). SAL briefs highlight unvaccinated pets currently boarded.
Long-form fields for major illness history, ongoing medication, dietary restrictions, and grooming preferences.
Upload and manage documents per pet (vaccination records, health certificates, vet reports). File storage on server.
Pets on active medication or special care are flagged in the SAL brief and highlighted during boarding.
Archived pets are removed from booking selection and operational views. Restorable by super admin.
Create a booking for one or more pets with individual stay dates, boarding service type, and add-on services.
Filterable booking list by status, branch, date range, and client. Sortable by date and status.
Full booking record: client, pets, stays, add-ons, pricing breakdown, invoice link, status history.
Select from configured boarding services (e.g. Standard Suite, Premium Suite) with pricing auto-calculated by the pricing engine.
Attach add-on services (grooming, medication, special meals) to any stay. Add or remove add-ons post-booking.
Invoice is auto-generated on booking creation with line items for boarding + add-ons. Recalculates on stay changes.
Guided check-in screen. Assigns kennel, records actual check-in date/time, updates booking status to active.
Guided check-out screen. Records actual departure, updates billing if stay extended, closes booking.
Cancel bookings with reason. Super admin can restore cancelled bookings from data management.
SAL automatically flags pets whose check-out date has passed but who are still actively boarded.
Card-based view of all kennels per branch showing current occupant, pet name, stay dates, and status. Colour-coded by state (vacant/occupied/cleaning).
Horizontal timeline showing kennel occupancy across a date range. Identify gaps and plan capacity.
Staff select or confirm kennel assignment during the check-in workflow.
Define kennels per branch: code, name, capacity notes, active/inactive status.
Assign staff members to specific kennels for responsibility tracking.
List all invoices with status filters (pending, partial, paid, overdue). Search by client or invoice ID.
Full invoice with itemised line items, subtotals, payment records, and adjustment history.
Generate a professional PDF invoice using mPDF. Includes facility branding, line items, payment terms, and QR code.
Send the invoice PDF as an email attachment to the client's registered email address.
Generate a WhatsApp deep-link with the invoice summary and payment instructions. Opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message.
Token-gated public URL (no WP login required) where clients can view their invoice summary and download the PDF.
Apply manual adjustments (discounts, corrections) to an invoice with a reason. Logged in audit trail.
Every invoice action (generated, adjusted, emailed, payment recorded, PDF viewed) is logged with timestamp, actor, and change details.
Record full or partial payments against an invoice. Supports multiple payment modes (cash, card, bank transfer, UPI, wallet).
Invoices unpaid beyond 7 days flagged as overdue. Highlighted in the SAL Accounts Snapshot and reports.
View tasks by branch, status, priority, and due date. Supports overdue filter.
Create tasks with title, description, branch, assignee, priority (low/medium/high/urgent), and due date.
Move tasks through open → in progress → done. Status changes logged with timestamp.
Assign tasks to specific staff members. Unassigned tasks are flagged in SAL briefs.
SAL morning and evening briefs list all overdue tasks by branch with title and due date.
Four priority levels: low, medium, high, urgent. High/urgent tasks highlighted in the task list.
Record branch expenses with description, amount, category, date, and optional notes.
Filter expenses by branch, category, date range. Displays running totals.
Create and manage expense categories (e.g. Feed, Veterinary, Utilities, Maintenance).
Daily expenses are included in the SAL Accounts Snapshot: count and total per branch.
Staff can email expenses to a configured IMAP inbox. Gemini AI classifies and creates the expense record automatically.
Public-facing inquiry form (no login required) on the WordPress frontend. Captures owner name, phone, email, pet details, preferred dates.
Internal inquiry list with status workflow: new → reviewing → onboarding → converted / rejected.
View full inquiry details, add internal notes, track status history.
System checks for existing clients/inquiries with matching phone/email before processing a new inquiry.
Generate a unique 64-char token URL for the client to complete their own onboarding form online.
Client-facing form: personal details, pet profiles, document uploads, T&C acceptance. No WP account needed.
Automated email sent to the inquiry owner immediately on form submission.
Staff can send a configurable WhatsApp message with the onboarding link directly from the inquiry detail screen.
One-click convert a completed inquiry to a full client + pet record. Linked to home branch.
Revenue by branch, month, and service type. Includes total billed, paid, and outstanding amounts.
Occupancy rate over time per branch. Average stay length and peak occupancy periods.
Trend charts for bookings by pet type, breed size, and boarding service category.
Expense totals by category and branch. Compare income vs expenses.
Breakdown of payments received by mode: cash, card, UPI, bank transfer, wallet.
All report views support custom date range selection. Defaults to current month.
Internal queue (opb_opsmail_queue) captures all operational events. 5 hook points: booking creation, check-in, check-out, payment recorded, invoice sent.
WP Cron flushes the queue every minute, delivering pending messages to the configured Telegram bot.
Polls a configured IMAP mailbox every 5 minutes for unstructured operational emails (e.g. expense submissions).
Incoming emails are classified by Google Gemini. Recognised expense emails are auto-created as expense records.
Staff can view the full event queue, see message status, and acknowledge processed items.
Admin UI to test Gemini prompts and OPSMAIL pipeline without triggering real events.
Displays status of all OPB cron jobs: last run, last success, next scheduled.
One-click test endpoints to verify Telegram bot connectivity and IMAP mailbox access.
Automated 07:00 Telegram brief: active boarders, today's arrivals/departures, overdue tasks, medication pets, exceptions.
Automated 19:00 Telegram brief: actual check-ins/check-outs completed, open tasks, day summary.
Automated financial brief: payments received today, unpaid/overdue invoices, expenses by branch. Numbers only, no interpretation.
Google Gemini formats the brief from structured OPB data. Produces Telegram HTML with sections, bullets, and attention items.
If Gemini is unavailable, a PHP-built fallback brief is delivered instead. No brief is ever silently skipped.
Super admins can override the Gemini prompt per brief type from the SAL dashboard. Custom prompt stored in WordPress options.
Generate a brief preview without sending. Inspect the snapshot JSON, prompt, Gemini output, and final Telegram message at each pipeline step.
Searchable log of all delivered briefs: type, trigger (scheduled/manual), Telegram status, timing, fallback indicator, and full message text.
Per-brief-type diagnostics: last run, last success, last failure with error message, next scheduled run. Cron active indicator.
Enable/disable each brief type independently. Set custom delivery time (24h HH:MM). Separate SAL Telegram chat ID supported.
Clients access the portal via a one-time password sent to their registered email. No WordPress account required.
Client-facing view of all their pets' current and upcoming boarding status.
Client can view their own booking history with stay details and status.
Client can view their invoices and download PDFs from the portal.
Sessions stored in opb_client_sessions with expiry. Access log maintained in opb_client_access_log.
Create and manage branches: name, code, location, phone, email, active status. Branches scope all operational data.
Create WordPress users with OPB roles, assign to branches. Role determines module access and data scope.
Define boarding service types with name, description, pricing (per night / flat), and size applicability.
Define add-on services (grooming, medication admin, special meals) with pricing.
Configure kennels per branch: code, name, size, status. Assign staff to kennels.
Central settings hub: facility name, support contact, legal T&C, privacy policy, messaging templates (email, WhatsApp), OPSMAIL credentials, SAL configuration.
Define expense categories used across all branches for consistent expense tagging.
Four custom roles: Super Admin (global), Branch Manager (branch-scoped), Reception (operational), Staff (tasks only). Enforced at every REST endpoint.
All automated messages (onboarding, invoice, acknowledgement) are fully editable in the customization centre. Support for {{PLACEHOLDER}} variables.
Custom facility name and logo displayed on the WordPress admin login page.
Super-admin-only bulk archive and selective restore of client records.
Archive individual pet records. Archived pets excluded from booking selection.
Cancel and archive bookings. Full booking history preserved for reporting.
Archive resolved or spam inquiries. Restorable at any time.
Import clients, pets, and historical booking data from legacy CSV or XLSX files.
Validate the import file and report errors/warnings without writing to the database.
Log of all past imports with record counts, errors, and timestamps.
Full REST API with 104 route registrations across 21 resource types. All endpoints use WP nonce authentication.
Standard WP plugin structure. Hooks into WP admin, REST API, cron, and user management. Zero WooCommerce dependency.
Single-page React application served in the WordPress admin. Client-side routing, React Router v6, no full-page reloads.
opb_cron_process_mailbox (5 min), opb_cron_process_telegram (1 min), opb_sal_cron (scheduled per brief). All hooks registered via OPB_Loader.
mPDF library installed via Composer generates print-quality PDF invoices. Images embedded as base64 for shared hosting compatibility.
Gemini API used in OPSMAIL (email classification) and SAL (brief formatting). Model and API key configurable. Falls back gracefully on failure.
Telegram Bot API used for OPSMAIL notifications and SAL executive briefings. Separate chat IDs configurable per channel.
